question: If P + Q = 6 and PQ = 4, then what is the value of P³ + Q³?
solution:
Given:

P + Q = 6 and PQ = 4

Formula Used:

(P + Q)3 = P3 + Q3 + 3 PQ (P + Q)

Calculation:

(P + Q)3 = P3 + Q3 + 3 PQ (P + Q)

⇒ (6)3 = P3 + Q3+ 3 × 4 × (6)

⇒ P3 + Q3 = 216 - 72

⇒ P3 + Q3 = 144

∴ Value of P3 + Q3 = 144
